title: Purple Oni Warriors
description: Four identical poses of a demonic purple-skinned oni character arranged in a horizontal row. The figure has white hair, horns, skull motifs on armor, and holds a small white fox-like creature on its shoulder.
prompt: A fierce purple-skinned oni demon with white spiky hair, curved horns, and glowing eyes, wearing ornate purple and black samurai armor with skull decorations. A small white fox sits on its shoulder. The character is shown in a dynamic walking pose with one arm raised, wearing geta sandals and a flowing purple sash. Multiple identical copies arranged in a row against a plain gray background, anime style, clean digital painting.
